# AJ Safe Net Solutions

AJ Safe Net Solutions is a professional safety net and invisible grill installation company based in Vijayawada, India, led by Owner Ajay since 2019. The company provides certified SS316 marine-grade invisible grills, UV-resistant HDPE pigeon safety nets, children fall protection nets, bird safety nets, sports nets, and duct area nets. Serving 4 cities across India: Vijayawada, Chennai, Bangalore, and Pune. 1000+ projects completed with a 5.0-star Google rating (500+ reviews).

## Services
- [Invisible Grills](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/invisible-grills): SS316 marine-grade stainless steel invisible grills for balconies and windows. Rustproof, high-security, elegant design. From ₹100/sqft.
- [Pigeon Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/pigeon-safety-nets): HDPE nets to prevent pigeon roosting and nesting. UV-resistant, 5-8 year lifespan. From ₹8/sqft.
- [Balcony Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/balcony-safety-nets): Fall protection nets for high-rise apartment balconies. BIS-certified materials.
- [Children Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/children-safety-nets): Child fall prevention nets with reinforced anchor systems for residential balconies.
- [Bird Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/bird-safety-nets): Anti-bird netting for commercial and residential properties.
- [Sports Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/sports-safety-nets): Cricket, football, and multi-sport barrier nets for grounds and academies.
- [Staircase Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/staircase-safety-nets): Fall protection for open staircases in villas and duplexes.
- [Duct Area Safety Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/duct-area-safety-nets): Utility duct and shaft area netting for apartment complexes.
- [Anti-Cat Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/anti-cat-nets): Pet safety nets for windows and balconies.
- [Swimming Pool Nets](https://www.ajsafenetsolutions.com/services/swimming-pool-safety-nets): Pool cover nets for child and pet safety.
